message: family 'bandit2arm_delta' declares no mean: it has no dpar named mu and no post$mean_fn, so fitted() and predict(type = \response\") have nothing to return. Ask for type = \"link\" or a dpar by name."
bandit2arm_delta(): trial numbers must be unique within a subject; 2 rows share one. A learning rule updates once per trial, so two rows at one trial have no order to learn in
bandit2arm_delta(): the response is the option chosen on each trial, coded 1 to 2. Two-level codings that start at 0 are the usual mistake; add one
